page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-ultramem-56 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the m4n server family. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 1488.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a high memory-to-core ratio of 26.57 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the m4n-ultramem-56 is designed for workloads requiring massive memory footprints relative to compute resources. The high density of RAM per core makes it suitable for large in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data analytics workloads where keeping entire datasets in memory is critical to performance.
